title: The Roswell Conspiracy with Nick Redfern (SITS CLASSIC)
description: British researcher Nick Redfern presents evidence that the 1947 Roswell incident involved classified human experimentation rather than extraterrestrial crash recovery. His findings suggest decades of UFO mythology may have provided perfect cover for concealing war crimes against developmentally disabled individuals used in high-altitude military tests.
source: Somewhere in the Skies w/ Ryan Sprague

title: Call for Disclosure on Capitol Hill (w/ David Grusch, James Fox, Leslie Kean, and Congress Members)
description: Congressional leaders unite with whistleblower David Grusch, investigative journalist Leslie Kean, and filmmaker James Fox to demand immediate government transparency on decades of UAP secrecy. This Capitol Hill transparency event represents the most significant legislative push for disclosure since the Pentagon's admission that unidentified aerial phenomena operate beyond current human technology.
source: Somewhere in the Skies w/ Ryan Sprague

title: The Alien Autopsy Film: A Retrospective
description: The 1995 Alien Autopsy television special represents a pivotal moment in public UFO consciousness that continues to influence disclosure narratives three decades later. Despite later admissions of fabrication, the film's cultural impact demonstrates how authentic extraterrestrial evidence might be received—and dismissed—by mainstream audiences.
source: Somewhere in the Skies w/ Ryan Sprague

title: Ep. 2314 Dean Alioto: The Experiencers: Full Disclosure
description: Filmmaker Dean Alioto, creator of The McPherson Tape, presents evidence from direct experiencer testimonies in his new documentary series. These firsthand accounts provide crucial documentation for understanding the scope and nature of ongoing extraterrestrial contact with civilians.

title: Ep. 2313 James Keenan: Skinwalker Ranch
description: Former intelligence operative James Keenan reveals the classified connection between Skinwalker Ranch's anomalous phenomena and a pattern of extraterrestrial activity documented across millennia. The evidence suggests government agencies have been studying these manifestations far longer than previously disclosed.

title: Ep. 2312 Bill and Jaci Kousoulas: Our Paranormal World
description: Former military intelligence officers Bill and Jaci Kousoulas reveal how paranormal encounters serve as interdimensional communication channels, providing critical evidence that consciousness transcends physical death. Their classified research demonstrates how grief-induced contact events mirror documented UAP communication protocols, establishing a unified framework for understanding non-human intelligence across multiple phenomena.
